fixes_applied: Added staleness check: require(block.timestamp - updatedAt < MAX_STALENESS)
Added price validation: require(price > 0) to reject negative/zero prices
Added round completeness check: require(answeredInRound >= roundId)
Implemented fallback oracle mechanism with automatic failover
Added try-catch for feed calls to handle revert scenarios
Added access control modifier onlyOwner for admin functions
Added minimum staleness validation (60 seconds) to prevent misconfiguration
Added comprehensive input validation in constructor
security_improvements: Prevents use of stale oracle prices that could be exploited
Rejects invalid price data (zero or negative) from Chainlink feeds
Validates round completeness to ensure data integrity
Fallback oracle ensures price availability during primary feed failures
Try-catch pattern prevents DoS from malformed feed responses
Access control prevents unauthorized parameter changes
Input validation prevents deployment with invalid configurations
test_coverage: 28 comprehensive test cases covering price validation, staleness checks, round completeness, fallback mechanism, access control, edge cases, and boundary conditions
